Address threshold tautology before claiming discriminating noise robustness: current threshold 0.25 lies below both behavioral modes (0.35 failure, 0.65 success) so TP=1.0 is insensitive to any noise that does not cross 0.35 (result.json:metrics.c3_per_condition, raw_evidence phase_b_cooccurring behavioral_score unique [0.35,0.65], validity_notes). Use continuous severity variation or calibrate threshold between modes (e.g., 0.40-0.50) with FP/TP ROC to show discriminating robustness, as noted in handoff do_not_assume threshold tautology.

validity_findings.finding: Behavioral scores are strictly bimodal 0.35 (refresh failure, 30%, N=155/480) and 0.65 (refresh success, 70%, N=325/480) — identical across all 4 co-occurring conditions. Detection threshold 0.25 is below both modes, so TP=1.0 tautologically regardless of noise. Recomputed threshold sweep on pooled B (n=480): TP=1.0 at 0.15/0.20/0.25/0.30/0.35, cliff to 0.677 at 0.40 (auditor recomputed). Noise robustness is thus not discriminatingly tested at 0.25; any noise preserving the discrete 0.35 mode will appear robust.

validity_findings.finding: Behavioral variance (std 0.1345-0.1465) is driven solely by Bernoulli p_refresh_success=0.7 mixture of two discrete points, not continuous severity. This limits generalizability to production token refresh where graded severity or continuous scores are expected. Same discrete model as parent EXP-PRODUCT-35476271728; audit does not falsify but bounds claim ceiling to discrete bimodal.

Production-like noise `error_format_variation` is not expressed on measured channels: for /api/session/status (behavioral channel) and /api/data, body is replaced after resp creation without rebuilding resp, so wire body remains original behavioral payload (behavioral_score remains 0.35/0.65, recomputed FP not affected). For /api/schema (structural channel), code explicitly `pass` — structural_signal std for error_format_variation is 0.4017, identical to baseline jitter (variable_length_data 0.4017, parent simplistic 0.4017), not elevated. Only pagination_metadata shows elevated structural variance (std 0.898 vs 0.4017). Effective production-like coverage is 3/4 types as implemented; claim of robustness to all 4 types as designed is not justified.

No inference to production OAuth/OIDC, CDN, network RTT, DB sessions; no continuous severity generalization; no threshold calibration beyond 0.15-0.35 tautology.
